invariants.rule: Finish passes TaskRef and consumes CH-01's exact result. ClosureSpec discovers/strict-replays the exact journal; missing/corrupt or any record_ref-null entry, including accepted/committed append ref, blocks/nulls probe. Only acknowledged record-bound append+record refs closes; stale snapshots/blockers/non-accepted block archive.
invariants.positive_case: ClosureSpec resolves complete ledger/register snapshots with both blocker sets empty and accepted; Finish owns only allow/block.
invariants.negative_case: After accepted pending row, journal rolls to older valid prefix/empty or supplies cross-position/repeated-row ref; fresh Finish sees later pass but must block/null probe.
test_evidence: cross-ID and baseline-relabel correction rejection scenario
fresh-session exact-path discovery and missing/corrupt journal scenario
append-ack before record-bound crash with later-pass scenario
older-valid/empty rollback plus cross-position/repeated-row correlation fixture

invariants.rule: Technical green, COMMIT_READY, or implementation_verified must not be reported as accepted.
invariants.positive_case: Technical closure reports implementation_verified and hands off exact runtime probes.
invariants.negative_case: A clean implementation review immediately produces accepted.

invariants.rule: The Skill and workflow must not claim that unchanged lifecycle scripts provide a fail-closed runtime guard.
invariants.positive_case: The contract explicitly states that it blocks the agent-owned finish-work path only.
invariants.negative_case: The documentation promises direct task.py or archive invocation is prevented.
